set.body: At the pinned eyesim revision, cover pearson, spearman, fisherz, cosine, l1, jaccard, dcov and emd for default and density inputs, and the supported multiscale subset. State whether each output is similarity, distance or transformed association; pin geometry intersection, constant, empty, zero-mass and unequal-scale behavior. Exit with independent analytic cases, optional-backend locks, direct-versus-lift agreement tests and truthful unsupported-method errors.
set.title: Complete the baseline map-comparison method matrix
